bounties.title: Close-up hands
bounties.blurb: Pokes, taps and pinches on windows very close to you, about a forearm's length from your eyes: the hand near your face, low in front of your chest and out to the side. Up close is where hand tracking loses the most fingers today.

bounties.title: Near misses
bounties.blurb: Taps and pinches that stop about 1 cm short, and a relaxed hand aiming between clicks, mixed with real taps. These teach the tracker what isn't a click, so it stops clicking or holding when you didn't mean to.

bounties.title: Three-finger pinches
bounties.blurb: Taps and scrolls with three fingers: the thumb on the index and middle fingertips together, mixed with ordinary taps and middle taps. Today these often read as a plain thumb and index tap.

bounties.title: Fists
bounties.blurb: Close your fist on a window, carry it and open your hand to let go: slowly, quickly, with each hand and both, and against pinches and card grabs. Fists closing and opening are still jumpy.

bounties.title: Sideways hands
bounties.blurb: Pinch, drag and tap windows at arm's length with your hand on its side, thumb on top, as for a handshake, plus lazy susan sweeps. A hand on its edge is the hardest for the cameras to judge for distance.

bounties.title: Pokes
bounties.blurb: Index finger pokes on windows within arm's reach, as on a touch screen: straight ahead, low near the lap, high and to the side, small buttons, holds and slides, both hands, and stopping just short.

bounties.title: Middle taps
bounties.blurb: Thumb to middle finger taps (right clicks) with the hand raised and pointing, mixed with index taps so the two can be told apart.

bounties.title: Index taps
bounties.blurb: Thumb to index taps with the hand raised and pointing at lit buttons, as with the hand ray: arm out and bent, two windows, high and low, far away, both hands, near misses and holds.

bounties.title: Hand gestures
bounties.blurb: Whole-hand moves: lazy susan sweeps and look-alikes that aren't, pulling a far window to you with a fist, pushing one away, turning one with your fist, and the palm-up menu tap.

bounties.title: Index taps in daylight
bounties.blurb: The index taps round in a room lit by daylight: by day, curtains open, no lamps needed. The cameras see infrared, and sunlight is what they find hardest.

bounties.title: Pinches
bounties.blurb: Pinch a window's bar or corner and drag, resize, tilt and stretch it to a ghost outline.

bounties.title: Three-finger grabs
bounties.blurb: Grab a window's edge like a playing card: hold it, place it, push it away, throw it.
